## Story Goal

Deliver (or verify + finish) a ticket conversation area on the Ticket Details page that:

1. Lists ticket messages chronologically (oldest → newest) with paging (`page`, `pageSize`, default 50).
2. Supports three message **types**: `CustomerMessage`, `AgentMessage`, `InternalNote`.
3. Supports a **channel** field with values `Web`, `Email`, `WhatsApp`, `SMS`, `LiveChat` (data-only; no external delivery).
4. Lets Admin/Manager/Agent authorized users post replies and internal notes; blocks customers from creating internal notes and blocks internal notes from any customer-facing endpoint.
5. Provides loading, empty, error, and duplicate-submission-prevention states in the UI.
6. Records a ticket-history entry when a message is added, reusing the existing history architecture.

Out of scope: real Email/WhatsApp/SMS/LiveChat integrations, AI suggested replies, AI chatbot, WebSocket/live updates, ticket status auto-transition on send.

## Product rules (from story)

- **Current:** existing TicketMessage entity with `Type` (Customer/Agent/InternalNote) and `Channel` (Web/Email/WhatsApp/SMS/LiveChat).
- **This story confirms:**
  - Agents on Web channel are the only channel actually emitted from the CRM UI.
  - Internal notes **must never** be exposed by any customer-facing endpoint (portal).
  - Message send **must not** trigger ticket status transitions.
  - Ticket history event on message create must **not** duplicate the message body.

## Backend Tasks

### 1 — Audit the message entity and DTO

**File:** `backend/CRM.Api/Tickets/TicketMessage.cs`, `backend/CRM.Api/Tickets/TicketContracts.cs`

Verify:
- `TicketMessage` has `Id`, `TicketId`, `AuthorId`, `Type` (enum), `Content` (non-null, `nvarchar`/text with max-length constraint), `Channel` (enum), `CreatedAt`, `UpdatedAt`.
- Enum values: `TicketMessageType = { CustomerMessage, AgentMessage, InternalNote }`; `TicketMessageChannel = { Web, Email, WhatsApp, SMS, LiveChat }`.
- Response DTO exposes: `id`, `ticketId`, `type`, `content`, `channel`, nested `author { id, name }`, `createdAt`. No `updatedAt` unless the executor confirms an existing consumer.
- If the DTO name or shape diverges from the intake sample, **prefer keeping the existing name** (backward compatibility) and document the divergence in `## Edge Cases & Failure Modes`.

### 2 — Audit `GET /api/tickets/{id}/messages`

**File:** `backend/CRM.Api/Tickets/TicketMessageEndpoints.cs`

Confirm:
- Requires authentication (`RequireAuthorization` chain).
- Verifies caller has ticket access (mirrors the pattern used by `TicketEndpoints`).
- Accepts `page` (default 1) and `pageSize` (default 50; clamp to a max — inspect surrounding endpoints for the standard cap, e.g. 100).
- Orders by `CreatedAt ASC`, then `Id ASC` as a stable tiebreaker.
- Returns envelope `{ items, page, pageSize, totalCount }`.
- Author name is resolved (join to user / customer). If the field is currently missing, add a projection step here.

### 3 — Audit `POST /api/tickets/{id}/messages`

**File:** `backend/CRM.Api/Tickets/TicketMessageEndpoints.cs`

Confirm:
- Rejects empty / whitespace-only `content` with `400`.
- Enforces max length (align with the DB column length). If no max exists, add `[MaxLength]` on the entity property and constant-share it with the request validator.
- Rejects unknown `type` / `channel` with `400`.
- Only Admin/Manager/Agent (via `RolePermissions`) may POST; Customer role is blocked from this endpoint entirely (customer messaging lives in `CustomerPortalEndpoints`).
- Only users with the internal-note permission may set `type = InternalNote`.
- `AuthorId` is taken from the authenticated principal, **never** from the request body.
- `CreatedAt` is set server-side (UTC).
- Adds a `TicketHistoryEntry` for the message (reference the message id, do **not** copy the body).
- Does **not** call any status-transition service.
- Returns `201 Created` with the created message DTO.

### 4 — Audit customer-portal internal-note filtering

**File:** `backend/CRM.Api/CustomerPortal/CustomerPortalEndpoints.cs`

Confirm every endpoint that lists or returns ticket messages applies `Where(m => m.Type != TicketMessageType.InternalNote)`. If any endpoint is missing the filter, add it and cover with a regression test.

**File:** `backend/CRM.Api.Tests/TicketMessagesEndpointsTests.cs`

For each intake test case not already covered, add a test:

- Customer message can be represented (seed one directly and GET it).

- Message is linked to the correct ticket (assert via DB query).
- `AuthorId` and `CreatedAt` recorded.
- Ticket history entry created on POST.

**File:** `backend/CRM.Api.Tests/CustomerPortalEndpointsTests.cs`

Add a regression test that seeds an `InternalNote` and asserts the customer-portal message listing does not include it.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Ticket does not exist** — GET/POST return `404`. Enforced in `TicketMessageEndpoints.cs`.
- **Caller not authorized for the ticket** — `403`. Same file.
- **Empty / whitespace content** — `400` on backend; Send button disabled on frontend after `trim()`.
- **Very long content** — reject `400` when over the max length; frontend shows validation before submit.
- **Invalid `type` / `channel`** — `400`. Rely on model-binder + explicit guard.
- **Customer sends internal note** — blocked by role check; add a regression test.
- **Internal note leaked via customer portal** — blocked by filter in `CustomerPortalEndpoints.cs`; regression test.
- **Duplicate Send click** — store early-returns while `sending === true`; button also disabled.
- **Concurrent sends by multiple agents** — no locking required; server orders by `CreatedAt`; verified by ordering test.
- **Network failure** — composer content preserved; toast raised.
- **Database failure** — 500 propagated; existing `ProblemDetails` middleware formats the response.
- **Author display when author is a Customer** — DTO must resolve the customer name, not just the user table. Verify the join path in step Backend §2.
- **Unknown DTO field divergence** — if the existing response uses `authorName`/`authorId` flat fields rather than a nested `author` object, keep it backward-compatible; update the intake sample in the plan is out of scope.

## Migration / Rollback

No new EF Core migration is expected. The existing `20260825094600_AddTicketMessagesAttachments` and `20260826153850_AddTicketMessageChannel` cover the schema.

If the audit uncovers a missing `MaxLength` at the DB level, generate a **new** migration named `AddTicketMessageContentMaxLength` in `backend/CRM.Api/Tickets/Migrations/` and update `TicketDbContextModelSnapshot.cs`. Rollback: `dotnet ef database update <previous migration>` from `backend/CRM.Api/`.

## Done Criteria

- [ ] Authorized users can view ticket messages via `GET /api/tickets/{id}/messages`.
- [ ] Messages are returned + rendered chronologically (ASC).
- [ ] Customer, Agent, and Internal Note types are all supported end-to-end.
- [ ] Internal notes are visually distinct in the UI.
- [ ] Authorized agents can send replies via `POST /api/tickets/{id}/messages`.
- [ ] Authorized users can create internal notes; unauthorized (including Customer) cannot.
- [ ] Backend validates content (required, non-whitespace, max length), `type`, and `channel`.
- [ ] `AuthorId`, `Channel`, and `CreatedAt` are persisted.
- [ ] Messages are stored in PostgreSQL with the correct `TicketId` foreign key.
- [ ] Customer-portal endpoints exclude `InternalNote`.
- [ ] UI implements loading, empty, and error states.
- [ ] Duplicate submissions are prevented (Send disabled while `sending`, store guard).
- [ ] Ticket history entry recorded when a message is created (no body duplication).
- [ ] All backend and frontend tests listed in `## Test Plan` pass.
- [ ] No external messaging integration, WebSocket, or automatic status change introduced.
- [ ] i18n keys present in both `en` and `ar` bundles.
